ownership_summary: Peter Mallouk (CEO of wealth manager Creative Planning), a minority owner since 2022, became majority owner in a deal that closed in December 2025, buying a 71% stake from the Illig family at an enterprise value of about $700m and taking his holding to 80% (SBJ: more than 80%). The Illig family keeps under 10% and day-to-day management, and Cliff Illig remains governor on the MLS board; the Patterson family (heirs of Cerner co-founder Neal Patterson, who led the 2006 purchase with Illig) is also named among the owners by Forbes.
